feedback.explanation: Add all the chosen lengths. Any arrangement totalling 12 metres works, using one to six permitted planks. Changing the order does not change the total.

The first line asks where the books are, so it ends with a question mark. The second tells of a discovery: a full stop is a calm observation and an exclamation mark is an excited one. Both discoveries work equally well. A question mark would make the discovery uncertain, outside this scene.
Both requests must hold: apples + pears = 9, and apples = 2 × pears. Check the total and the relationship separately.
11 × 8 = 88; 12 × 12 = 144; 7 × 7 = 49. The two 88 cards are interchangeable. Check the requested quantities and operations separately.
3 eighths + 2 eighths = 5 eighths, or 5/8 of a whole ribbon.
These specifies lanterns and the specifies path, so both are determiners. Us refers to the owners; They refers back to the lanterns. Those are pronouns here.
Accept means agree to receive the parcel, consistent with returning it only when the label does not match. Except means leave out or exclude; that does not express receiving the matching delivery.
The account moves from spotting the problem to fetching a tool, freeing the kite and handing it back.
The first instruction places switching off before opening the case.
2 m = 200 cm. The total is 200 cm + 75 cm = 275 cm.
3 pm is 15:00. Keep the 25 minutes: 15:25, or 925 minutes after midnight.
85 minutes is 1 hour 25 minutes. 09:45 + 1 hour = 10:45; 25 minutes later is 11:10, or 670 minutes after midnight.
23:50 to midnight is 10 minutes; midnight to 00:10 is 10 more. 10 + 10 = 20 minutes.
08:00 is before 09:00, which is before 10:00: breakfast, gates open, bell.
Ribbon: 200 p − 125 p = 75 p change. Label: 100 p − 40 p = 60 p change.
Oak and Elm together have 15 + 12 = 27 visitors. Ash has 24; 27 − 24 = 3 more.
Although and Even though both mark the surprising contrast. Because states a cause and If states a condition; those do not explicitly express the requested contrast.
An apostrophe marks the omitted o in not. Straight and curly apostrophes are equally correct here. A comma does not mark a contraction.
Add all the chosen lengths. Any arrangement totalling 10 metres works, using one to six permitted planks. Changing the order does not change the total.
2 groups of 5 use 2 × 5 = 10. 5 × 2 gives the same total. Adding just the two given numbers does not count every displayed object. Check the requested quantities and operations separately.
12 counters shared among 2 trays gives 6 each. Check: 2 × 6 = 12. Check the requested quantities and operations separately.
4 × 2 = 8 counters in the large pack. Check the requested quantities and operations separately.
One of two equal parts is shaded: 1/2 of a whole. Multiplying both counts by two gives the equivalent fraction 2/4.
Five tenths is 5/10, written 0.5. The notation 0.05 means five hundredths.
The long hand at 6 means 30 minutes. The short hand has passed 9, so the morning time is 09:30, or 570 minutes after midnight.
Clockwise from North passes toward East. One quarter turn ends at East.
Oak and Ash each have 20 visitors, more than Elm’s 10. Either Oak or Ash is correct.
Rewrite means write again. Miswrite means write incorrectly; unwrite suggests undoing writing, not writing again.
Hear means notice a sound. Here identifies a place and cannot describe what the ears do.
Start mixing means begin mixing; stop mixing means cease mixing. Swapping them reverses each instruction.
Opens and lifts are verbs. Carefully tells how Mira opens, and gently tells how she lifts, so both are adverbs here.
And adds the two welcome actions. Because would claim a reason; if would make bell-ringing depend on flag-waving. Neither extra relation was requested.

The comma separates bread from cheese in this list. A full stop or question mark ends the line before the list is finished and leaves cheese and apples as a fragment, rather than keeping the required instruction together.
Matching opening and closing quotation marks enclose all the spoken words and their full stop. Either offered quote style is valid; mixing single and double marks does not make a matching pair.
The cushion instruction names the box beneath the bench.
Rubbing his hands for warmth supports the inference that Bo feels cold.
Naming Tess makes the bag’s owner explicit and preserves the supplied facts.
